criteria.text: DMD with a confirmed mutation amenable to exon skipping of target exon 45, 51, or 53 (FDA indication under accelerated approval).
Patient age meets FDA labeling for the requested product (approval criterion 1; no numeric age specified in this PDF).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist who specializes in DMD (approval criterion 2).
DMD diagnosis confirmed by submitted laboratory testing demonstrating a dystrophin gene mutation amenable to the applicable target exon (45, 51, or 53) skipping (approval criterion 3).
Serum cystatin C, urine dipstick, AND urine protein-to-creatinine ratio submitted prior to initiation (approval criterion 4).
Documented baseline muscle strength score submitted from ONE or more listed assessments; select one qualifying assessment (approval criterion 5).
Documentation of concurrent corticosteroids unless contraindicated or intolerant (approval criterion 6).
No concomitant use with another exon skipping medication (denial criterion 2).

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid DMD antisense oligonucleotides Criteria. Version: 1; Original: 2/26/2022; Approval: 4/15/2022; Effective: 6/1/2022.
Products: Exondys 51 (eteplirsen), Amondys 45 (casimersen), Vyondys 53 (golodirsen), Viltepso (viltolarsen). No product-specific clinical predicates are added beyond the PDF.

Encoded: closed indication, approval criteria 1–7, and denial criterion 2. Denial criterion 1 (failure to meet approval criteria) is covered by the approval clauses. Age is an FDA-label attestation without invented numeric thresholds.

Accelerated approval is based on increased dystrophin production in skeletal muscle. Continued approval may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 6 months; reauthorization approval up to 12 months if the prescriber documents improvement or stability from baseline and current weight is submitted.
Quantity (notes only): Viltepso maximum dose 80 mg/kg, HCPCS J1426; Amondys 45 maximum dose 30 mg/kg, J1427; Exondys 51 maximum dose 30 mg/kg, J1428; Vyondys 53 maximum dose 30 mg/kg, J1429.

Cautions (notes only): see package inserts linked in the source PDF: Exondys 51 https://www.exondys51hcp.com/sites/default/files/2020-08/EXONDYS51PI.pdf ; Vyondys 53 https://www.vyondys53.com/static/patient/assets/Vyondys53_(golodirsen)_Prescribing_Information.pdf ; Amondys 45 https://amondys45.com/Amondys45_(casimersen)_Prescribing_Information.pdf ; Viltepso https://www.viltepso.com/prescribing-information .
Remaining gaps: FDA-label age and documentation verification, duration, reauthorization response, quantity enforcement and package-insert cautions require manual review; this pack remains partial.

No evaluate-linked alternatives. DMD peers elevidys (gene therapy) and emflaza (corticosteroid) have distinct indications, mechanisms and specialty fact values; shared patient facts cannot safely be merged without additional translation. Peer packs are unchanged. PDL status remains unknown.
